observations: Photo shows a bare engine assembly (no vehicle body) sitting on a dirty workshop/yard floor.
Other engines and a transmission are visible in the background, consistent with a parts yard, not a single car being sold.
No visible manufacturer plate, engine code stamp, or VIN tag on the block or head in the photo.
A watermark reading 'Victor Nazeco' and an overlay reading 'SPARK 30C' with camera metadata are present; these are photographer/stock markings, not proof of make or model.
Hoses, wiring, and some surface grime are visible; no fluids, no running state, no sound can be judged from a still photo.
No odometer, dashboard, or vehicle chassis is shown, so mileage and 'never opened' cannot be checked.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: No engine code, plate, or stamp visible in photo 0; 'LX460' is not a recognized Lexus model designation, which cannot be checked further from this image.
No import paperwork, shipping label, or port photo shown.
Seller repeats the claim in words only; still no video or audio of the engine running.
Requires audio/video of running engine; not provided, verbal reassurance does not substitute.
No odometer or vehicle shown; mileage cannot be read off an engine photo.
No close-up of head bolts, gasket seams, or seals to check for prior disassembly marks.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance from the seller is not visual proof; no new photo or video accompanies this message.

risks.risk: Exact engine model/displacement cannot be confirmed, which drives most of the price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/stamp plate on the block or a legible VIN/parts tag
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic used engine, lowest plausible bracket for the claimed type

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may knock despite claim
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine cold-starting and idling with audible sound
Photo of an odometer or ECU mileage readout tied to this specific engine
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/high mileage, not low mileage

risks.risk: Engine could have been opened/rebuilt with non-OEM parts, affecting longevity
risks.proof: Close-up photos of head bolt paint seals, gasket mating surfaces, and any rebuild stickers
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly opened/rebuilt, not 'never opened'

risks.risk: Import origin (Belgium/Tokunbo) cannot be confirmed, which matters for buyer trust and resale
risks.proof: Photo of shipping/customs documents or container/port tags matching this engine

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/stamp or manufacturer plate on the block
Video of the engine running (cold start, idle, revved) with audible sound
Close-up photos of head bolts, gasket lines, and seals showing no prior disassembly
Any documentation (shipping, customs, or dealer invoice) showing origin and claimed mileage
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change what the image shows; the engine code is still unreadable and running condition still unproven, so a worst-case price still cannot be set without the requested shots.
